meta.title: Donate
meta.description: Where a gift to Friends of Animals will go, and what we can and cannot do yet.

hero.title: Help children grow up kind to animals
hero.lead: Your gift pays for competitions, certificates and awareness work that turn a child's drawing into a lesson the whole neighbourhood sees.
hero.easy: Under 18? Please don't give money. Ask a grown-up. You can help by making art for a competition.
hero.photoCaption: A dog resting on the beach at sunset

notLive.title: Online giving isn't open yet
notLive.body: We are setting up payments and receipts properly before we take a single rupee. When giving opens, you will be able to give once, or monthly from an account, in rupees.
notLive.rules: For now we can only accept gifts from Indian citizens, paid from India. We cannot accept foreign contributions.

why.title: Why give to this
why.body: A child who spends a week drawing the crow on the wire looks at that crow differently afterwards. A school that hangs those drawings in the corridor gets a few hundred more children looking. That is the work: Student Creativity, then Public Awareness, then Compassion for Animals.
why.notShelter: We are not a shelter, and we don't rescue or treat animals ourselves. We grow the habit of kindness, so that more people help the animals around them.

map.title: Where the money will go
map.lead: These are the things a gift will pay for. We won't print percentages until there is real money to count; the actual split will be published once giving opens.

competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.body: Judging, certificates for every participant, and posting original artwork to judges and back.

schools.title: Schools
schools.body: Guides and materials for teacher coordinators, so running a competition in class is simple.

awareness.title: Awareness
awareness.body: Seasonal kindness guides, cited stories and printed displays of children's work.

safety.title: Safety and privacy
safety.body: A secure website and careful consent records, because this is children's work and children's data.

items.tax: We can't promise you a tax deduction. We will only mention a tax benefit once we hold it and can show its number on this page.
items.foreign: We can't accept money from outside India.
items.minors: We can't take gifts from anyone under 18. A parent or guardian can give on their behalf.
items.rescue: We can't take in animals or pay for their treatment.

legit.title: Is Friends of Animals legitimate?
legit.lead: It is right to ask before you give. Here is what you should be able to check, and what is still missing.
legit.honest: Until every line above is filled in, please wait before giving. We would rather you wait than give on trust alone.
legit.publish: Once giving opens, we will publish what came in and where it went on a transparency page.

receipts.title: Receipts and tax
receipts.body: Every gift will get a receipt by email. Until our tax status is confirmed, receipts will not carry a tax section.

csr.title: Companies, foundations and partners
csr.body: If your company or foundation would like to support competitions in schools, write to us. Tell us which cities or age groups you have in mind.
